name: crewtives-playground
description: A museum of web experiments, among them 4D.OS: a three.js engine that shows a moving subject at every moment at once, in five worlds.

scripts.build: tsc --noEmit && vite build -c sites/4d-os/vite.config.ts && vite build -c sites/playground/vite.config.ts
scripts.deploy: rm -rf dist && npm run build && cp deploy/_redirects deploy/.assetsignore dist/ && wrangler deploy -c deploy/wrangler.jsonc
scripts.deploy:preview: rm -rf dist && npm run build && cp deploy/_redirects deploy/.assetsignore dist/ && wrangler versions upload -c deploy/wrangler.jsonc --preview-alias landings
